thread:
Irene (People Ops): dropping a tiny 'sparkline' format for goals + micro-self-review lines. aims: super short, ladder-aware, and paste-ready for PRs or 1:1s :zap:
Sam (Eng Manager): curious what 'sparkline' means in practice?
Irene (People Ops): format = Commitment / Signal / Timespan. Commitment: one-line outcome. Signal: one metric or evidence to watch. Timespan: quarter or 8-week sprint. Keeps goals tight and comparable across levels.
Pri (SWE): can we see an example for a reliability goal?
Irene (People Ops): example: "Outcome: reduce model-serving rollback rate to <2%/wk; Signal: weekly rollback events 6 -> 1.5; Timespan: Q3"
Sam (Eng Manager): love that. add a 2-line manager coach script for nudging career lift?
Irene (People Ops): added micro-script: "Where would you add one more stretch so this work grows your scope? What support would make that safe?"
Pri (SWE): need a 2-line self-review blurb that fits a PR or changelog
Irene (People Ops): self-review PR blurb: "Commitment I owned: <one sentence>. Evidence: <link(s) + primary metric delta>. Next step: <one short ask>"
GoalsBot: reminder: suggest managers request these 7 days before calibration window (auto-note)
Sam (Eng Manager): also include a quick peer-feedback one-liner for calibration: helps keep signals clear
Irene (People Ops): peer-feedback one-liner: "Observed: <behaviour/outcome>. Evidence: <link>. Impact: <user/business/tech>. Suggest: <hire/maybe/pass or next-career-step>."
Pri (SWE): this is slim enough to actually use. can you paste a copy/paste block I can drop in 1:1 agenda?
Irene (People Ops): pasted below — feel free to copy into Slack or templates.

--- paste-ready: sparkline goal (1 line) ---
- Commitment / Signal / Timespan
- e.g., "Reduce model rollback rate <2%/wk / rollback events 6 -> 1.5 / Q3"

--- paste-ready: manager 1:1 micro-check (3 bullets) ---
- Confirm commitment & owner
- Agree primary signal (metric or evidence)
- Ask the career-lift script above

--- paste-ready: self-review PR blurb (2 lines) ---
- Commitment: <one-line outcome> + key metric delta
- Evidence & next step: <links> 2 short ask

--- paste-ready: peer feedback one-liner ---
- Observed / Evidence / Impact / Suggestion

--- end paste ---

Sam (Eng Manager): perfect. i'll trial this in my team's next 1:1s and report back. thanks Irene :sparkles:
